bounded_slice.question: Before a dirty rebuild of a DirectorySource package, does the inspected Cargo compiler-input path independently enumerate the package tree or reject files that are absent from .cargo-checksum.json?

sources.verified_observation: compile() calls fingerprint::prepare_target; on a dirty job it constructs rustc work. rustc() calls prepare_rustc(). The command-building path uses add_path_args for the target source argument.

path_args() chooses unit.target.src_path() (or the metabuild path), and add_path_args() passes that single source path plus a cwd to rustc/rustdoc. This function does not enumerate the package tree or consult .cargo-checksum.json.
The returned production-code hits were src/sources/directory.rs and src/ops/cargo_vendor.rs; no src/compiler hit was returned. Documentation/tests also matched.

bounded_slice.result: Within the exact inspected dirty compile-input path, no independent Cargo-side package-tree enumeration or rejection of checksum-unlisted files was found before rustc is prepared. The compiler command is rooted in the manifest-derived target source path and package cwd rather than a Cargo-generated complete file manifest. This narrows the earlier uncertainty: DirectorySource checksum verification is not supplemented here by a second compiler-input tree walk.
bounded_slice.negative_evidence_scope: This is negative evidence only for the inspected Cargo-side command-construction path and literal checksum references visible in the pinned official repository search. It does not prove that rustc, build scripts, procedural macros, or other project-defined logic cannot read an extra unlisted file, and it does not prove that no indirect Cargo subsystem can enumerate files through a different path.

scope_guard: Inspected only the official pinned Cargo compiler command path sufficient to trace dirty-unit rustc preparation plus the pinned repository literal .cargo-checksum.json search. Did not execute Cargo, inspect any dependency repository, inspect rustc implementation, run a build script, broaden to a concrete dependency target, or start a second semantic leaf.
residual_uncertainty: An unlisted extra file may still affect a dirty rebuild if rustc module/include resolution, a build script, a procedural macro, or other project-defined logic reads it.
The inspected path does not establish whether an indirect Cargo subsystem outside compiler command construction enumerates package files before execution.
Initial creation and provenance of a complete local dependency set without network, richer-mode execution, or user execution remain unresolved.
End-to-end richer-mode outcome parity remains unverified.
